SOL CAUSAL COSMOLOGY v4 — 2026-10-09
Final finite-class theorem, explicit target health, and completed internal audit
Status: internally derived and internally reviewed within the exact stated class.
No external validation, priority, empirical exclusion, or all-dark-sector completion.

0. What has actually been proved
=================================
Einstein gravity plus a finite positive-kinetic, positive-Fourier-gradient
first-derivative scalar medium cannot reproduce every healthy cosmological
linear metric response whose physical tensor sector is exactly Einstein.
The obstruction is an action-conjugate stress identity, strengthened by a
nonstationary causal no-cancellation lemma; it is not a definition of an
effective stress tensor or a one-solid reconstruction.

In the action class below, exact equality of the complete sourced retarded
tensor response to GR implies zero dark scalar anisotropic stress for EVERY
scalar solution and homogeneous initial mode. An explicit healthy f(R)
theory has the matched full tensor response and violates that conclusion
under a conserved positive dust source. Its initial-data-independent scalar
identity is also derived here. The full frozen derivations are v1 sections
1–5, v2 sections 3–5, and the indispensable v3 tensor parametrization
clarification. No previous frozen file was edited. This file consolidates
the theorem and adds the health/source consequences below.

1. Exact hypotheses and proof
==============================
Use signature (-,+,+,+) and the physical metric g seen by all known matter.
The dark realization class is

 S=integral sqrt(-g) [M^2 R/2+P(phi^A,B^{AB})]+S_known[g],
 B^{AB}=g^{mu nu} partial_mu phi^A partial_nu phi^B.       (1.1)

There are arbitrarily many but finitely many real scalar components. Their
internal space is a finite real orthogonal SO(3) representation with any
integer spins and multiplicities. P is smooth and invariant under this
common internal rotation. Material spin-1 fields are independently shift
symmetric. On the homogeneous isotropic background, singlets may depend
on time, the only spatial field gradients are

 b_i^{aI}=beta_a delta_i^I, beta_a=lambda_a/a,
 phi^{aI}=lambda_a x^I,

and higher-spin fields have zero background. Nonzero invariant constant
background values belong to spin 0. General P cross-couplings, entropy
and higher-spin order-parameter fluctuations are ad
